description: Ed25519 sign/verify round-trip on a canonical byte payload. This is the foundational golden vector: a signature produced by aumos-trust-core must verify in Python (via the PyO3 binding) and Go (via cgo) identically.
notes: Signing key intentionally omitted — only the verifying key and signature are needed to verify. The signing key was used once to produce this signature and is not part of the public vector. Re-generate by running: trust-core key-gen | trust-core sign --key <sk>.
